All Communications to be addressed to the Chief Constable.

CITY POLICE OFFICE.
TOWN HALL.
BRADFORD, YORKS.

14th. November, 1935.

SECRET.

THOMAS RAWSON.
CHIEF CONSTABLE

OUR REF. 94.290/D.
PF.43817/D.S.9.a.
YOUR REF. .....................

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter of the 12th. instant, and to inform you that the matter shall have attention.

Yours faithfully,

Colonel Sir Vernon C. W. Kell,
K.B.E., C.B.,
Box No. 500,
Parliament Street, B.O.,
London, S.W.1.

Chief Constable.
